Description:
Removes your faction's fixed starting hero. When you found your capital, you pick your first hero from a draw of three. Faction quests that featured the classic starting hero now use the hero you picked. 

[h2]A Hero Is Needed[/h2]
For Tahuks, Order of Zelevas, Severed Claws and Sandshapers, their starting normally hero features in their first faction quest. This quest is normally triggered around turn 5 (Normal speed), if you have already settled. If you settle at a later turn, it will trigger the moment you settle. Since this mod introduces a draw after you settle, this initial quest would be empty because you do not have a hero yet. This means the dialog would stop when the hero was supposed to talk, and the dialog would play again on subsequent turns until the player had picked a hero, which is a bit janky. For this reason a mini quest, 'A Hero Is Needed', is introduced when a player founds its capital late with one of these factions. This quest asks the player to recruit a hero and keep it for one turn. The turn after the player has recruited its hero the normal faction quest will begin.

[h2]Version 1.1[/h2]
Fixed a bug which could let the player draw 3 heroes on each new city.
